ure Gompertz-type form r(t)·P·(lnK(t) − ln P) with linear r(t) and lnK(t) gives NMSE 0.10, so the time dependence is more complex than that.
- A linear regression on {P, P·lnP, P², P²·lnP, P³} × cubic-in-t reaches NMSE ≈ 2e-4, which means the P-structure is close, but it is not an exact closed form.
